blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 85 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Lists are not decoration
blocks.body:
- **Bullets** :  a set of things, no order.
- **Numbers** :  only when the order is the work. On a task, use real steps.
- **A note** :  a tip or a warning beside the work. Not a fourth step.

If you use numbers because they “look serious,” you are decorating. Stop.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Note** :  a tip or warning beside a step or a paragraph.

lessons.title: One list, one note, the right page

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: The explaining page has numbered steps, or the how-to’s steps became bullets, or the note is a fake extra step.

Expected: Bullets on the explaining page. Real steps plus one note on the how-to. Both clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open your explaining page (what-a-cut-flower.dita). Add a bullet list of two flower parts. Not numbered :  these are not steps.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open your how-to (change-the-water.dita). Confirm the steps are still real steps, not a bullet list.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: On the how-to, insert a Note under step 1: Recut over a bin so stems do not slip.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Do not turn the note into another step. Do not put the note on the hours table.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Save both files. No red error.

blocks.summary: Bullets on the explaining page. Real steps plus one note on the how-to. Both clean.

blocks.q: Flower parts (stem, bloom) on an explaining page should be…
blocks.why: Parts are not a procedure. Bullets are fine. Numbers would look like a how-to.

blocks.q: A note on a how-to is for…
options: A warning or a tip beside a step
blocks.why: A note is a tip beside the work. It is not a fourth step and not a lookup table.
